title: Roku Error 009
shortDescription: Roku TV error 009: device online but cannot reach Roku servers.
fullDescription: Roku error 009 indicates the router is online but cannot reach Roku servers. Most cases clear by re-running Network setup with the correct Wi-Fi password and a stable router.

fixSteps.title: Re-enter Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Network > Set up connection > Wireless; type password carefully.

fixSteps.title: Move closer
fixSteps.instruction: Bring TV within 15 ft of router for setup.

faq.a: Roku TV error 009: device online but cannot reach Roku servers.

title: Overheating Warning
shortDescription: Red light and overheating message on Roku stick.
fullDescription: Streaming sticks plug directly into HDMI; the metal frame around the port acts as a heatsink. Use the included HDMI extender to move the stick away from heat.

causes.cause: Stick mounted directly behind hot TV

fixSteps.title: Use HDMI extender
fixSteps.instruction: Plug the included extender between stick and TV.

fixSteps.title: Reposition
fixSteps.instruction: Move away from amplifiers and direct sun.

faq.a: Red light and overheating message on Roku stick.

title: Voice Remote Won't Pair
shortDescription: Roku Voice Remote Pro stops pairing.
fullDescription: Hold pairing button in battery compartment 5 seconds until LED blinks rapidly.

faq.a: Roku Voice Remote Pro stops pairing.

title: Private Listening Drops
shortDescription: Audio in Roku app cuts in and out.
fullDescription: Private Listening streams audio over your home Wi-Fi to the phone. Distance, congestion, or 2.4 GHz interference cause drops.

fixSteps.title: Switch to 5 GHz
fixSteps.instruction: Connect phone and Roku to 5 GHz SSID.

fixSteps.title: Use wired headset
fixSteps.instruction: Plug headphones into Voice Remote Pro.

faq.a: Audio in Roku app cuts in and out.

title: OS Update Loop
shortDescription: Device reboots repeatedly into update screen.
fullDescription: An incomplete update can leave Roku in a loop. Wired Ethernet (Ultra) or factory reset typically resolves it.

faq.a: Device reboots repeatedly into update screen.

title: Error 009
fullDescription: Internet not detected. Common indication on Roku Streaming TV/streaming device. Resolve with reset, app reinstall, or HDMI swap.

fixSteps.title: Update app/firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Update affected app or system firmware.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall/contact
fixSteps.instruction: Reinstall app or contact streaming service.

whenToCallPro: If reset and reinstall fail, contact streaming service or TV manufacturer.

faq.a: Often yes — app reinstall clears corrupted data.
Streaming errors are usually app/network, not hardware.
